<color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldNews id=0 width=1 height=1></color> Mr. Skott and Ms. Rakshmi's wedding was recently held lavishly in Astropolis. Boasting a star-studded guest lineup and a romance that transcends life and death, this grand ceremony quickly became the city's entertainment focus.
Renowned scholar of the Council of Mundanites, Professor Ratio, was invited as wedding officiant. The Astral Express Trailblazer {NICKNAME}, Strategic Investment Department Director Aventurine, Guinaifen and Sushang from the multi-million-viewers streaming team "Ghost-Hunting Squad," "Genius Society" member #81 Miss Ruan Mei, and Chrysos Heirs Tribios and Cifera were all in attendance alongside other guests. <color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldAmazed id=1 width=1 height=1></color> Multiple media outlets commented that this might be the most talked-about wedding guest lineup in Astropolis this Amber Era.
After the wedding announcement, topics such as "Who exactly is Skott?" and "Who exactly is Rakshmi?" quickly shot to the top of the trending topics list, and remained there for six consecutive system hours.
Reports indicate that Mr. Skott was originally an ordinary employee in the IPC's Strategic Investment Department. During a mission in Planarcadia, he was tragically murdered by Fulwish. Subsequently, the IPC's Postmortem Employment Center utilized relevant technology to restore Mr. Skott in the form of a ghost, allowing him to continue dedicating himself to his unfinished work. <color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldShocked01 id=2 width=1 height=1></color>
With the IPC's support, Mr. Skott founded the "Lyndon™ EmbodiMech" brand, which quickly earned a stellar reputation thanks to reliable product performance and distinct market positioning. During the startup period, he reunited with his beloved Ms. Rakshmi, whom he had missed out on when alive. Side-by-side, the two navigated career ups and downs, reaffirming their feelings for one another through mutual support, and ultimately achieving success in both love and career. <color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldyHappy id=3 width=1 height=1></color>
From an ordinary employee to the founder of a renowned brand, and from an accident in Planarcadia to a highly publicized wedding in Astropolis, Mr. Skott's journey proves once again that a career and relationship truly worth cherishing cannot easily be bound by life and death. <color><icon SpriteName=EmojiFifthWorldAmazed id=4 width=1 height=1></color>
This wedding has not only borne witness to a love transcending life and death, but also serves as the most romantic and vivid footnote to the "IPC Dream."
